title: fix(console): a user with no personal language gets the app's declared default language, not the browser's
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XFqWUeTvdjtsCuVJwjkdjAS)_

Fixes #33231

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：没设个人语言（`sys_user.locale` 为空）的用户，控制台语言现在按「个人语言 → 应用声明的默认语言（discovery `locale.default`）→ 浏览器语言 → `en`」决定，页面的 `lang` 属性跟着走。做法是控制台问服务端 `/auth/me/localization` 时，把应用默认语言作为 `Accept-Language` 带上（设备上没有手选语言时）；服务端不改，个人语言照旧最先生效。
- 为什么改：应用声明 `i18n.defaultLocale: 'zh-CN'` 后，服务端给这类用户发通知用中文，控制台却跟着浏览器显示英文，同一个设置两张脸不一致。
- 风险与回滚：⚠️ discovery 总会给出默认语言，没写 `i18n` 块的应用给的是 `en`。所以**没写 `i18n` 块的应用里、没设个人语言的用户，用中文浏览器现在看到英文**（与服务端通知用的语言一致）；用户在语言菜单里选一次就会写入个人语言、从此以个人语言为准。已有设备上缓存的旧语言还会再显示一次页面加载，下一次起按应用默认语言，不会在使用中途突然切换。回滚即 revert，只动控制台两个文件。
- 先看：`ui/apps/console/src/languageSeed.ts` 的 `loadAppDefaultLocale` 与 `fetchAndCacheSeed` 里新增的 `Accept-Language`；`ui/apps/console/src/LocalizationFetchProvider.tsx` 里 `const preference = …` 那一行；`languageSeed.test.ts` 末尾 `objectstack#33231` 的三个用例。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run apps/console/src/languageSeed.test.ts apps/console/src/LocalizationFetchProvider.test.tsx apps/console/src/__tests__/localizationBootDedup.test.tsx`，预期 3 个文件 38 个用例全绿，其中「en-US 浏览器 + 应用默认 zh-CN → 显示 `zh-CN|取消`」。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。若不接受「没写 `i18n` 块的应用一律按 `en`」这一后果，请在本 PR 上说，合并前可以改。

## What changes

- **`languageSeed.ts`** (`@object-ui/console`).
  - New `loadAppDefaultLocale(serverBase)`: reads discovery `locale.default` once per page load through `getSharedDiscovery` (`@object-ui/data-objectstack`), the same shared request the data adapter's `connect()` makes, so it adds no request of its own. It never rejects; a failed or unreadable discovery answers `undefined`. `startedAppDefaultLocale()` hands the started read to the in-app provider.
  - `seedTenantLanguage` starts that read on every boot with no explicit choice on the device (an explicit choice still returns first, spending nothing).
  - `fetchAndCacheSeed` (the first-visit race) waits for the read and states the app's default as the `/auth/me/localization` request's `Accept-Language`. The server's rungs are unchanged: `sys_user.locale` answers first, the stated default answers the rung below it. With no default served, no header is stated and the browser's own goes out, as before.
- **`LocalizationFetchProvider.tsx`** (`@object-ui/console`). With no explicit choice on the device, the every-boot read states the same app default (it used to send the browser's header). This read is what refreshes the cached language seed, so the next boot's language follows the app default, and the dates and numbers it feeds (`useDisplayLocale`) follow it too. With an explicit choice it still states that choice. Seed and provider state the same header, so on a first visit they still share one request.
- **Where each language source sits, measured.** At boot `@object-ui/i18n`'s `resolveBootstrapConfig` reads: the device's explicit choice (`objectui-locale`: the cache of `sys_user.locale` that `useSignedInUserLocale` applies, or a language picked on this device) → the cached seed (`objectui-locale-seed`, the server's answer above) → the browser (`pickInitialLanguage`) → `en`. After first paint `useSignedInUserLocale` applies a set `sys_user.locale`. This PR changes only what the seed holds for a user with no personal locale: the app default instead of the browser. `@object-ui/i18n` is not edited; the browser detection in `i18n.ts` named on the claim's file surface did not need to change.
- **Changeset** `.changeset/33231-console-app-default-locale.md`: `@object-ui/console` patch (it ships the built SPA in `dist`), both declaration lines.

## Tests

- `languageSeed.test.ts`, new describe `the app's declared default outranks the browser (objectstack#33231)`. A fake server answers `/auth/me/localization` by its three rungs (the user's own locale, else the request's stated `Accept-Language`, else the browser's), and discovery serves a default or a 404. Each case runs the boot as `main.tsx` does (`seedTenantLanguage`, `preloadBootstrapLocale`, then renders `I18nProvider` with a probe) and reads the rendered language, a translated label and the html element's `lang`:
  - no personal locale, default `zh-CN`, `en-US` browser: `zh-CN|取消`, html `lang` `zh-CN`, seed `zh-CN`, one localization request, nothing written to the explicit-choice slot;
  - personal `en`, default `zh-CN`, `zh-CN` browser: `en|Cancel`, html `lang` `en`;
  - no default served, `ja` browser: `ja|キャンセル`, html `lang` `ja`, and the request stated no `Accept-Language`.
- `LocalizationFetchProvider.test.tsx` (the `objectstack#27625` describe): with no choice and the app default read started, the read states `zh-CN`, the dates render `2026年10月11日`, and the seed cached is `zh-CN`. The existing "with no choice, the read states nothing" case still holds when no default read was started.
- `__tests__/localizationBootDedup.test.tsx`: the three existing request-budget cases now answer the discovery URL as a server with no default and count localization requests only; new case: seed and provider both stating `zh-CN` still share ONE localization request.
- Existing `languageSeed.test.ts` cases: helpers answer discovery with a 404 (the browser path the old cases model) and count localization requests; "does not wait when a seed is already cached" now asserts no localization request (the discovery read it starts is the adapter's own).
- Ablations through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` on head `12260995`, each over the three files (38 tests), restored with blob equal to HEAD and `git diff HEAD` empty:
  - the seed's stated `Accept-Language` disabled (`languageSeed.ts`, blob `c3685942` to `198db16e`): 2 failed, 36 passed. Red: the zh-CN/en-US boot case (`expected 'en-US|Cancel' to be 'zh-CN|取消'`, the card's symptom) and the one-request case.
  - the provider's app-default preference disabled (`LocalizationFetchProvider.tsx`, blob `16feb1f7` to `115611f6`): 2 failed, 36 passed. Red: the provider case (`expected null to be 'zh-CN'`) and the one-request case.
  - The personal-locale and no-default cases stay green under both, as they should: they pin what must not change. Console tests import these modules from source, so no build sat between mutation and run.

## Acceptance notes

- **An app with no `i18n` block now gives no-locale users English, whatever the browser.** Discovery's `locale.default` is required in `DiscoverySchema` and is never absent: the dispatcher's floor is `en`, and service-i18n's adapter answers `options.defaultLocale ?? 'en'`. So the console cannot tell a declared `en` from no declaration, and the ruled order makes the browser decide only when discovery answers no default (unreachable, or a server without the field). This is the language the server already writes to these users in. The seat read it as the literal ruling, not a new decision; it is called out here as the maintainer's veto window.
- **One page load of delay on devices that already hold a seed.** A device whose cached seed was the browser's language boots in it once more; that boot's provider read refreshes the seed to the app default and the next boot follows it. A true first visit whose discovery-plus-localization reads miss the 500 ms race boots in the browser language and caches the answer for the next boot. Both keep the existing rule that a boot never switches language mid-session.
- **Not changed, stated:** the sign-in page on a device that has never had a signed-in user still renders in the browser language (the endpoint answers no locale before sign-in, and the ruling's order is for a user); after a change of owner on a shared browser, `useLanguageResetOnOwnerChange` still resets to the browser language for the rest of that page load, and the next boot follows the app default.
- **The discovery read is shared with the adapter** only when the keys agree: the boot keys it by `SERVER_BASE` (`VITE_SERVER_URL` with trailing slashes removed), the adapter by `VITE_SERVER_URL` as written. With a trailing slash configured the two are separate requests on a first visit.
- **File surface:** the claim names `languageSeed.ts`, `LocalizationFetchProvider.tsx`, the browser detection in `i18n.ts`, their tests and the changeset. `__tests__/localizationBootDedup.test.tsx` is a test of the two modules (its request count had to separate the discovery read); `i18n.ts` was not touched.
- **Declaration lines measured on the diff:** no published export, key or schema arm changes; `@object-ui/console`'s package exports (`plugin.js`) are untouched and `@object-ui/i18n` is not edited. `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`, as the claim opened.

## Verification

Run on head `12260995` (base `origin/main` `d4fbb4db`).

- Whole console project, `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run apps/console/`, on `b3237cdb`: Test Files 310 passed, 1 failed (311); Tests 3191 passed, 1 failed. The red was `localizationBootDedup.test.tsx` counting the new discovery read as a localization request; `12260995` makes that file count localization reads only (and adds the shared-default case), and the file is green above. `12260995` changes no source file, only that test.
